verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right with a strong headline and a big CTA, but it is cramped. The bottle cap touches the top edge, the headline's 'z' nearly runs into the overlapping corner circles, the CTA sits tight to the right edge, and the 3-line body copy is crowded. B's SOLSTICE logo is tiny and almost touches the bottle cap, and the body copy and CTA label are too small to read at banner size. Its small, centred content block also leaves a lot of empty space, so the hierarchy is weak.
